mapper.update: update voucher_seckill set remaining_stock = remaining_stock - 1 where id = #{seckillId} and status = 1 and remaining_stock > 0
mapper.select: select vs.id as seckillId, vs.voucher_id as voucherId, v.title as title, v.description as description, vs.total_stock as totalStock, vs.remaining_stock as remainingStock, vs.start_time as startTime, vs.end_time as endTime, vs.status as status from voucher_seckill vs inner join voucher v on vs.voucher_id = v.id where vs.status = 1 and v.status = 1 and vs.end_time > #{now} order by vs.start_time asc

select vs.id as seckillId, vs.voucher_id as voucherId, v.title as title, v.description as description, vs.total_stock as totalStock, vs.remaining_stock as remainingStock, vs.start_time as startTime, vs.end_time as endTime, vs.status as status from voucher_seckill vs inner join voucher v on vs.voucher_id = v.id where vs.id = #{seckillId} and vs.status = 1 and v.status = 1 limit 1
